question: By what name and characteristic motion is the conch-related mudrā declared?
premises: The mudrā is declared as gālinī.
It is connected with the conch.
It is characterized by being moved around.
inference: The conch-related mudrā known as gālinī is defined by its circulating motion.
uncertainties: The exact technical sense of śaṅkhasya in this gesture is not fully explicit.
plain_english: This mudrā is declared to be Gālinī, performed by moving the conch gesture around.
